mapper.select: SELECT mr.request_id AS id, i.item_name, mr.created_at AS occurred_at FROM material_request mr JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id WHERE mr.status = 'REQUESTED' AND mr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY mr.created_at DESC

SELECT mr.request_id AS id, i.item_name, mr.updated_at AS occurred_at FROM material_request mr JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id WHERE mr.status = 'SHORTAGE' AND mr.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY mr.updated_at DESC

SELECT vq.quote_id AS id, i.item_name, vq.submitted_at AS occurred_at FROM vendor_quote vq JOIN procurement p ON p.procurement_id = vq.procurement_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id WHERE vq.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND vq.submitted_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY vq.submitted_at DESC

SELECT vq.quote_id AS id, i.item_name, vq.created_at AS occurred_at FROM vendor_quote vq JOIN procurement p ON p.procurement_id = vq.procurement_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id WHERE vq.vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND vq.status = 'REQUESTED' AND vq.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY vq.created_at DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id AS id, i.item_name, p.ordered_at AS occurred_at FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id WHERE p.selected_vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND p.status = 'ORDERED' AND p.ordered_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY p.ordered_at DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id AS id, i.item_name, p.shipped_at AS occurred_at FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id WHERE p.status = 'SHIPPED' AND p.shipped_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY p.shipped_at DESC

SELECT mr.request_id AS id, i.item_name, mr.issued_at AS occurred_at FROM material_request mr JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id WHERE mr.department_id = #{departmentId} AND mr.status = 'ISSUED' AND mr.issued_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY mr.issued_at DESC
